body.name: Exhibited four-label atomic dual
body.construction: Place risk mass \(1/2\) at each of \((1/\sqrt2,2)\) and \((-1/\sqrt2,2)\), coverage mass \(\lambda_4=90909437727/50000000000\) for each of labels \(02\) and \(12\) at \((0,2)\), and zero coverage mass for the other labels. Substitute these measures into the exact Lagrange-dual integral defining \(L_4\).
